query_results.query: How does thermal management affect electric-aircraft motor power density?
query_results.answer: Thermal management affects electric-aircraft motor power density by reducing the thermal management airflows associated with the power electronics and genset generator, while also reducing or eliminating some component cooling airflows. The LNG fuel still has some residual cooling capacity after cooling the genset generator and aircraft power electronics, but it was not considered here to reduce other genset cooling requirements. Additional improvements are realized for the overall system from the higher heating value (per fuel weight) of the LNG and slightly greater genset output power for a given fueled engine size, which results from less electric component losses. Offsetting some of these benefits is the LNG tank volume and weight.

query_results.query: What electrical faults can cause partial or complete propulsion-power loss?
query_results.answer: Electrical faults can cause partial or complete propulsion-power loss. These include potential power electronics faults such as AC supply-line failure, diode failure, link capacitor failure, transformer failure, DC supply voltage failure, transistor failure, motor terminal supply line failure, and loss of cooling, controller failures, motor speed control, loss of cooling, controller failures, loss of motor speed control, internal shorts, thermal runaway/fire, aging and internal mechanical stress, energy density degradation, depleted state of charge, battery management system faults, external short/open circuit, reduction in energy storage capacity, discharge/charge rate, and complete loss of functionality.

query_results.query: Why are high-temperature sensors useful in electrified aircraft systems?
query_results.answer: High-temperature sensors are useful in electrified aircraft systems because they can monitor and detect the thermal conditions of the battery cells, power electronics, and other components. This information can help improve safety, accelerate battery and next-generation battery adoption, and provide warnings before off-nominal conditions turn into catastrophic consequences. Additionally, sensors can be fabricated on the separator between battery electrodes, allowing for microfabrication techniques such as shadow mask and photolithography.

query_results.query: What role can magnetic gearing play in an electric propulsion drivetrain?
query_results.answer: Magnetic gearing can eliminate lubrication requirements, prevent physical contact between gear teeth, and reduce vibration and failure mechanisms associated with mechanical gears. It also has a lower mesh stiffness and expected lower variation in mesh stiffness, which can lead to a reduced vibration signature. It is not suitable for high power gearboxes, such as those in larger civilian rotorcraft, because of the magnet temperature limit and individual magnet interaction weaker than one gear tooth pair, and routine and costly maintenance.

query_results.query: What certification considerations affect electrified aircraft powertrains?
query_results.answer: Electrified aircraft propulsion systems require certification of propulsion flight deck controls and displays, as well as the format in which thrust commands are delivered to the EAP system and how EAP health and status information is conveyed back to the flight crew. The certification team must address the propulsion flight deck controls and displays, the format of thrust commands, and EAP health and status information. The EPA and FAA must work with industry partners to assess the regulatory and standards gaps in their technology.

query_results.query: How can battery energy density influence hybrid-electric aircraft performance?
query_results.answer: Battery energy density influences hybrid-electric aircraft performance by affecting vehicle sizing, power and thermal budgets, and the feasibility of high utilization rates. For STOL or VTOL aircraft, power density is more important than energy density. Electric aircraft require a reasonable projection of battery energy density by 2020, and batteries must have high C-rate charging capability and low internal resistance for rapid charging.
